'''Brophys''' was a notorious [[spice merchant]] and [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] who was said to be responsible for the destruction of [[Kala'din (city)|Kala'din]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].
